name: Medhavi Putra/Putri Chhatravritti Yojana
nodalDept: Labour, Employment, Training and Skill Department
briefDescription: "Medhavi Putra/Putri Chhatravritti Yojana" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. Only the residents/domicile of the state of Jharkhand can apply to this scheme.
descriptionMd: "Medhavi Putra/Putri Chhatravritti Yojana" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. Only the residents/domicile of the state of Jharkhand can apply to this scheme. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the official website of the department (http://shramadhan.jharkhand.gov.in). The scheme provides scholarships of up to ₹ 50,000/- to the children of the registered workers.
eligibilityMd:
1. The applicant should be a domicile in the state of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should be a Student.
1. The applicant should have passed the previous examination with atleast Second Division or 45% marks in any examination (except Class 1st to 5th) OR have got admitted/enrolled in the course on the basis of a competitive examination.
1. The applicant should be the child of a Worker registered with the 'Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board)'.
1. The scholarship can be availed by upto two children of the Registered Worker.
